review_candidates.title: مهندس طباعة فلكسو (Flexo Production Engineer)
review_candidates.location: Qesm El Obour, Al Qalyubiyah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: ‏⁦ مهندس إنتاج (تخصص طباعة فلكسو) تعلن شركة كبرى في مجال صناعة وتجارة البلاستيك بمدينة العبور عن حاجتها لمهندس إنتاج متخصص في طباعة الفلكسو للانضمام إلى فريق العمل. المسؤوليات: الإشراف المباشر على خطوط إنتاج طباعة الفلكسو وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. ضبط معايير الجودة والألوان أثناء عملية الطباعة. متابعة الصيانة الدورية للماكينات وتقليل الهالك من المواد الخام. إدارة طاقم الفنيين والعمال في قسم الطباعة لتحقيق المستهدف الإنتاجي. الشروط المطلوبة: خبرة عملية سابقة في مجال طباعة الفلكسو (Flexo). السن: لا يتعدى 38 عاماً. المؤهل: بكالوريوس هندسة (يفضل تخصص إنتاج أو ميكانيكا). الجنس: ذكور فقط. المزايا: تأمينات اجتماعية وطبية. حوافز انتظام شهرية. مواصلات مجانية تغطي خطوط (بلبيس - شبين - المرج - مؤسسة الزكاة - شبرا الخيمة). مواعيد العمل: 7:30 ص - 3:30 م (السبت - الخميس).

review_candidates.title: Application Engineer
review_candidates.description: About ITT: ITT Inc. (NYSE: ITT) is a diversified global leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions serving the flow, aerospace and defense, transportation, industrial, and energy markets. Through operational execution, innovation, and disciplined capital deployment, including strategic acquisitions such as SPX FLOW, ITT partners with its customers to deliver enduring solutions to the key industries that underpin our modern way of life. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, ITT has a market cap of roughly $20 billion and employs more than 15,000 people across 40 countries and serves customers in approximately 125 countries. Following the acquisition of SPX FLOW, the company is expected to generate $5.4 billion in annual revenue. Our businesses are organized in three distinct segments, each based around our core engineering DNA: Flow Technologies: A global leader in, providing a broad portfolio of pumps, valves, mixing and agitation equipment, heat transfer, homogenizers, separation, water and wastewater treatment, and engineered process solutions. Our leading brands include the iconic Goulds Pumps (with more than 175 years of history), Anhydro, APV, Bornemann, Bran+Luebbe, C’treat, Engineered Valves, Gerstenberg Schröder, Habonim, Johnson Pump, Lightnin, Philadelphia, Plenty, PRO Cast, Rheinhütte, Seital Separation, Stelzer, Svanehøj, Tigerholm, Uutechnic, VIDAR, Waukesha Cherry-Burrell. Motion Technologies: A global leader in brake pads (ICE and electrified brake pads) and shock absorbers (energy absorption solutions) for transportation applications. Our leading brands include Friction Technologies, KONI and Axtone. Connect and Control Technologies: A leader in critical applications for the aerospace, defense and industrial markets, including harsh environment connectors and control components. Our leading brands include ITT Cannon, Enidine, Aerospace Controls and kSARIA. Position Summary To prepare commercially sound quotations and assist the sales force in winning orders through technical clarifications as part of a team. Prepare proposals for customers within deadlines. Respond to technical questions timely and accurately. Enter clean orders on all our factories and develop sufficient knowledge to properly administer all orders whether they are for pumps, parts, valves, services, or orders for returned material. Expedite data, information, and orders with all factories. Develop strong relations with internal factory customers, representatives and customers where applicable. Essential Responsibilities Review of contract Technical specifications for Engineered Pumps. Optimize and select the suitable Pump using selection tool to meet the contract requirements and fix the strategy for quotation and ensuring the selected products and materials for required application. Prepare Request for quotations (RFQ) for buy outs - Drivers, Mechanical Seals and Systems, Couplings and other Major accessories required for complete quotation. Follow up with Sub suppliers of major accessories for Quotation and Review of Vendor offers. Interface with Product engineering for hydraulic modifications and Pricing whenever required. Interface with factory for costing and commercial quotations. Price working and Preparation of techno commercial offer to the Customer with detailed clarification & deviation list. Resolve technical queries for completeness and technical correctness of the offer. Attend Technical Meetings with customer and resolve their Technical queries. Update and share job related progress in every steps with the reporting manger. Preparation of clean factory order upon receipt of order from Customer and participate in order hand over meeting. Resolving order related re-conciliations with the factory Project Managers. Update and maintaining job data base and involving in Continuous Improvement activities. Support achievement of the company’s orders targets year on year Be familiar with all ITT Goulds Pumps products and services Be familiar with company organization structure, chain of command, policies and procedures. Support Field Sales Engineers, Area Sales Managers and representatives in all aspects of business with the objective of increasing sales and improving customer service. Expedite data, information, and orders with all factories, enable to highest filling of orders. Other duties as requested by management. Position Requirements Education: Mechanical, Electrical or Chemical Engineering Degree Experience: 8 years of experience in industrial centrifugal pumps field with solid knowledge in pump selection, sizing and hydraulic requirements. Demonstrated experience in interpreting Customer technical requirements Vs. manufacturer offering range. Well familiar with related industrial standards, such as API610, API682, ISO 5199, ANSI B73…etc. Familiar with other industrial equipment involved in scope of pump skid such as Motors, Mechanical Seals and Systems, Couplings, Engines, Turbines, Instruments…etc. Comprehensive understanding of tendering process for industrial business (timely bids preparation, sub-components RFQ preparation, handling TQs and negotiating deviation lists…etc.) Previous experience in customer facing function including frequent interactions with external customer and closing the loop with internal counterparts such as sales teams, advanced procurement teams, factories teams, product teams…etc. Preferred experience in major EMEA regional EPCs and End Users specifications such as Shell, Aramco, ADNOC, Saipem, Technip, Tecnicas Reunidas, ENPPI…etc. Skills/Knowledge: Fluent in English (other language plus) Team Oriented Strong PC Skills with Windows and Office Programs Self -Starter Ability to establish relationships with Customer base Excellent Communication Skills
